 Description
 These 8 timer video MP4 files can be used to display timers by inserting them in slides or using your device's video player, Google Drive, or YouTube for your students during classwork or small group instruction to stay on track!

 THIS PRODUCT INCLUDES: 
 ■ 1 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 2 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 5 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 10 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 15 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 20 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 25 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ 30 minute timer video (MP4 file)
 ■ Link to Google Drive folder with video files
 ■ Link to YouTube playlist with ad-free videos
 ■ Multi-page product info guide

 These timer videos are also included in the following products:
 ■ Bright Google Slides Templates With Timers | EDITABLE 
 ■ Rotation Boards | EDITABLE 

 NOTE: This product ONLY includes the timer video files. It does not include any additional templates. 

 ___________________________________________________________________________

 These pre-made video timers can be virtually displayed and can be resized as needed for students to reference during instruction. You can have the video timer fill the entire screen and project it at the front of the classroom or you can incorporate it into a directions slide as a smaller size.

 TIMER VIDEO FEATURES: 
 ■ Simple black background
 ■ White numbers that are easy to read
 ■ Timers turn red for the last 10 seconds
 ■ Silence during the timer countdown so it can be paired with any desired music
 ■ Alarm that sounds for 5 seconds when the timer reaches zero
 ■ Video audio can be muted if the alarm is not needed

 TIMER VIDEO DISPLAY OPTIONS: 
 ■ Play the video using your device's default video player (such as QuickTime or Windows Video Player)
 ■ Open the Google Drive folder and play the video from Google Drive
 ■ Open the YouTube video playlist link and play the video on YouTube (ad-free)
 ■ Embed or insert the video into a slideshow program (such as Google Slides, PowerPoint, or Canva)

 NOTE: The "timers" are MP4 video files that can be played on your device as is or inserted into other files such as slideshows.

 ___________________________________________________________________________

 CAN YOU PAUSE OR RESET THE TIMERS? 
 Since the timers are video files, you can also pause the video in order to pause the timer at any point. To reset the timer, just restart the video by closing and reopening it or clicking and dragging the player head to the start of the video.

 WHAT IF I NEED A SPECIFIC TIMER THAT'S NOT INCLUDED? 
 If a more specific timer length is needed that isn't included in the video files, you can choose a timer video with a longer duration and scroll to find the timestamp of the time you need before playing the video. For example, if you need a 16 minute timer, you can choose the 20 minute timer and then start the video at the 4:00 mark. 

 This product is for PERSONAL USE ONLY! These video files cannot be used for commercial use.
